|  |  |  | 0000500 | mismatch | zoning.code: expected "C-2", got null |

Also failing, below the alert threshold or waiting for a second run:

Alert rule: a layer alerts when it is broken (error or mismatch) for at least 3 parcels in one run, or when it meets the threshold (3 parcels, or any parcel for the parcel lookup) in two consecutive runs. This issue closes when no layer meets the threshold.
